payout_quote: For each New Friend that opens and funds an Eligible Account, up to five (5) New Friends per calendar year, the Referrer will receive, under these standard Terms and Conditions, a $50 Referral Reward deposited into their Referrer Account within thirty (30) days after completion of the New Friend enrolling, opening and funding the Eligible Account.
steps: Be a current Ally Bank customer selected to participate as a Referrer (notified via email or online banking) with a Referrer Account open and in good standing.
Copy your unique Personal Link and share it with friends via text, social media, email, or group chat.

Your friend uses your Personal Link to enroll, opens an Eligible Account (Ally Bank Savings or Spending Account) within 30 days of enrollment, and funds it with any amount within 30 days of opening (trial deposits do not count; same email for enrollment and account opening).
Your $50 Referral Reward is deposited into your Referrer Account within 30 days after your friend's enrollment, opening, and funding are complete.
catches: Cap: 5 successful referrals / $250 per calendar year under the standard terms.
Friend must be brand new to Ally Bank - anyone who has had any Ally deposit account since January 1, 2024 is an Excluded Friend and earns you nothing.
Only Savings and Spending Accounts count - Money Market, CDs, IRAs, trust/UGMA/UTMA/fiduciary accounts are excluded.
Only current Ally customers selected/notified by Ally can be referrers - not everyone can refer.
Program runs through December 31, 2026 and Ally can change or cancel it at any time without notice.
Ally treats the Referral Reward as interest for tax-reporting purposes (1099-INT reporting applies).
You get no visibility into whether a friend enrolled, opened, or funded - the process is confidential to you.
biggest_catch: Only 5 paid referrals per calendar year ($250 cap), the friend must be completely new to Ally Bank, and Ally can change or kill the program at any time.
eligibility: Current Ally Bank customers selected and notified by Ally to participate as Referrers; Referrer Account open and in good standing.
timing: Each $50 Referral Reward paid within 30 days of the friend's enrollment, account opening, and initial funding completing.
